environment.description: Deployed on an EC2 instance (t3.medium) running the Flask app directly via gunicorn behind an nginx reverse proxy. The nginx config performs TLS termination and forwards all traffic to the app on port 8080. No request filtering or inspection is applied at any layer. The SQLite database file is on an EBS volume mounted at /var/data/. Security groups allow inbound HTTPS from 0.0.0.0/0. The X-Authenticated-User header is set by a downstream client library but not enforced server-side.

config.proxy: nginx 1.24 with proxy_pass to localhost:8080, no modsecurity
config.network: VPC public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
config.database: SQLite 3.40 on local EBS gp3 volume
